skills.name: eqa-decision-protocol
skills.description: Guides design decision-making during EQD-AI pipeline development using structured AskUserQuestion options instead of prose. Use when a design choice, implementation approach, or architectural question requires a decision — especially when multiple valid options exist. Triggers: "should we", "what approach", "how should we handle", "which option", "decide", "I was thinking", "what do you think about implementing", "option A or B", "design choice", "tradeoff".

skills.name: eqa-ideas-maintenance
skills.description: Maintains IDEAS.md for the EQD-AI project — adding new entries, updating status tags, and keeping the Last updated footer accurate. Use when a sprint task is completed, a decision is made, a new idea surfaces, or an item's status changes. Triggers: "add to IDEAS.md", "update IDEAS.md", "mark as done", "move to ready", "log this idea", "add to next iteration", "this is ready to implement", "park this for later", "note this".

skills.name: eqa-arch-review
skills.description: Reviews external architecture plans or implementation suggestions against EQD-AI's DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.md. Use when an outside agent (Gemini, another LLM, team member) proposes changes to the pipeline design, data model, or implementation approach. Triggers: "review this plan", "what do you think of this design", "Gemini suggested", "another agent proposed", "architecture proposal", "external plan", "evaluate this", "assess this implementation", "what do you make of this".

skills.name: eqa-repo-standards
skills.description: Enforces EQD-AI repository quality standards: syntax verification, test confirmation, selective staging, commit message format, and documentation updates. Use when preparing to commit code, after completing a sprint task, or when diagnosing a test failure. Triggers: "commit", "push", "all tests green", "tests passing", "tests failing", "test failure", "git add", "ready to commit", "let's commit", "do commit".
